item.title: Amtrak cancels 20 Acela, Northeast Regional, Keystone trains due to winter weather issues
item.description: Amtrak has canceled multiple Acela, Northeast Regional and Keystone Service trains Thursday and Friday due to winter weather-related equipment issues.

item.title: Political fight over DC tax law underway just as filing season starts
item.description: Republicans in Congress are pushing to overturn another local D.C. law. Council removed the local tax code from President Donald Trump’s "One Big Beautiful Bill," which had tax cuts for D.C. filers. item.title: Man charged in series of car tire thefts at Fairfax County hotels, police say
item.description: Fairfax County police say a man is in custody after committing a series of tire and rim thefts at hotels across the county. At 10:45 a.m. on Oct. 24, 2025, officers responded to the Extended Stay located at 12055 Route 50 in Fair Oaks for a report of a robbery.
